narrative.intro: Bollinger Shipyards Lockport L L C obligated $2.3B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Fiscal-year detail shows a jump in FY26 after earlier years of $259M in FY21, $168M in FY22, $195M in FY23, $54.5M in FY24, and $181M in FY25. Current-year totals are partial for the fiscal year to date. This profile describes a vendor concentrated in large, recent awards from DHS, with FY2026 obligations dwarfing prior single-year totals.
